entities.name: Abu Mansur al-Azhari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Manṣūr Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Azharī or simply known as Abu Mansur al-Azhari, was a lexicographer, philologist and grammarian of Arabic. a prominent philologist of his time, known for his talents and the transmitting of philological knowledge. His most important work is Tahdhib al-Lughat.
